page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at top right. Main text in one column, a short paragraph at the top continuing from the previous page, a rule, then a chapter heading with an italic summary, then the body text. Section mark "§. 1." in the left margin. Catchword "quam" at the lower right. Signature "S 2" at the foot.

main_text.l: Archelai diem ; seu quod idem est , ad quintum aut sextum
Decembris in anno Jul. xlii. quo die per quartum
characterem illuxerat xliv a nativitate Christi dies: quod
si ergo a quinto aut sexto Decembris retro numerando
demas dies 44. invenies verum tempus
nati Christi : est autem x Decembris a calendis Januariis
339 — 44 = 295 qui est Octobris dies 22. a. At-
que ita invenimus annum nati Christi xlii Jul.
ejusque mensem Octobrim , & praeter propter diem.
CAPUT II.

l.i: Sacra puerperii die à nato Christo xli oblata , post
mortem Herodis fuisse celebrata ex collatione locorum

main_text.l: P[?]endet ergò totius causæ definitio
ex hâc thesi, quod nos sacra puerperii
Hierosolymis in templo oblata fuisse
non ante Herodis mortem , sed paulo
post eam (quicquid in contrarium velint interpretes) sta-
tuamus , atque nobis demonstrandum sumamus : seu
quod idem est , non ante fugam in Ægyptum , sed
proximè à reditu ex Ægypto sacra illa fuisse celebrata
inter egressum ex loco exilii , & ingressum in
Galilæam, ejusque civitatem Nazarethan. Hoc exigit
locorum Matth. 2:22.23. & Luc.2:39. collatio. Uterque
locus agit de Josephi cum Mariâ ejusque puero reditu
in civitatem suam, & ingressu in urbem Nazareth
tan-quam

page.notes: The large decorated initial at the start of "Pendet" is hard to read; it looks like a P, rendered here as P[?]endet. The word that follows it is not certain either. The left margin holds only the section mark "§. 1.". No other printed margin text is visible. A small mark before "Archelai" was treated as a bullet and left out. The first paragraph continues from the previous page.
